name: APAAR ID
notes: Store only when available and with required consent/process.

name: Aadhaar Last 4 Digits
notes: Do not store full Aadhaar number in Moodle baseline.

name: Masked Aadhaar
notes: Example xxxx-xxxx-1234 only; no full number.

name: External Aadhaar Vault Reference
notes: Use only if a legally compliant external secure store is used.

name: Parent Annual Income Range
options: Not provided|Below 1 lakh|1-3 lakh|3-5 lakh|5-10 lakh|Above 10 lakh

name: Current Academic Year
notes: Current academic year used for promotion/rollover reporting.

name: Current Board Code
notes: Current board code, for example GSEB or CBSE.

name: Current Medium Code
notes: Current medium code, for example GUJ or ENG.

name: Current Grade Code
notes: Current grade/program code such as PRE01, STD05, STD11_SCI, UNI_UG_CSE_Y1 or LMS_CERT_DATA.

name: Current Stream Code
notes: Current stream code such as GEN, SCI, COM, ART, ENG or CSA.

name: Current Division Code
notes: Current school division such as A or B.

name: Student Status
notes: Current lifecycle status for academic-year rollover.

name: Previous Academic Year
notes: Previous academic year before latest promotion.

name: Previous Grade Code
notes: Previous grade code before latest promotion.

name: Previous Stream Code
notes: Previous stream code before latest promotion.

name: Previous Division Code
notes: Previous division code before latest promotion.

name: Last Promotion Date
notes: Date on which student was last promoted or status changed.

name: Last Promotion Result
notes: Latest promotion action result, for example promoted, retained, alumni.
